note: Read with an assumption: the vehicle line prints 'GMC Bulldog Step-Van (Living Space 6 CF, spoof kit)'. Living Space takes 2 CF x occupants x lifestyle rating and costs one month of that lifestyle per occupant (Double Clutch pp.129-130), and the book doesn't print the occupants: 6 CF is one occupant at Middle (rating 3, 5,000¥) or three at Squatter (rating 1, 3 x 500¥). It is read as one occupant, the runner, at rating 3 (an item reading, not a correction; the owner may rule otherwise).
